meta.name: to-spec
meta.description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker — no interview, just synthesis of what you've already discussed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把讨论内容自动整理成需求文档并提交到项目跟踪系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你们在讨论中确定了需求，需要快速生成规范文档并同步到项目管理系统
copy.tagline_en: Turn your conversation into a spec and publish it to the project tracker
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn discussions into structured specs and push them to your issue tracker

howto.what: 将你与 Claude 的讨论自动转化为一份详细的产品需求文档（spec），并直接发布到项目的问题跟踪器中，无需你额外填写。
howto.when: 当你希望把刚才讨论的功能细节整理成正式规范时触发。

say.text: 把这次对话转成一个 spec 并发布到 issues 里。
say.note: Claude 会探索仓库、编写规范并发布。

say.text: 为刚才讨论的登录功能写一份 PRD 并提 issue。
say.note: Claude 会综合已知信息生成规范。

howto.what_en: Automatically converts the current conversation and codebase understanding into a detailed product spec (PRD) and publishes it to the project's issue tracker without further input from you.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want the discussed feature details to be synthesized into a formal spec and published.

say_en.text: Turn this conversation into a spec and publish it to issues.
say_en.note: Claude will explore the repo, write the spec, and publish.

say_en.text: Write a PRD for the login feature we just discussed and file it.
say_en.note: Claude will synthesize what you already discussed.
